HOW MUCH: the reserve's value must cover the asset's supply after the issuance. This caps the         amount, never the caller.      Guarantee, exactly: given an honestly held admin role on the asset, no issuance exceeds the reserve.      The gate cannot bind the admin role above it; that role can grant itself the issuer role.      Scale. owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

coveredSupply().notice: The largest total supply the reserve covers right now. Reverts if the price is unusable.

headroom().notice: How many more units the reserve covers; zero when at or over capacity.

issue(address,uint256).notice: Issue `amount` units to `holder` if the caller is listed and the reserve covers the new supply.

maxPriceAge().notice: Longest age, in seconds, the price feed's last update may have.

setIssuer(address,bool).notice: Owner decides which accounts may ask the gate to issue.
